an3.156:1.3: Āgāḷhā paṭipadā, nijjhāmā paṭipadā, majjhimā paṭipadā.
an3.156:1.5: Idha bhikkhave ekacco evaṃvādī hoti evaṃdiṭṭhi --
an3.156:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco acelako hoti muttācāro hatthāvalekhano na ehibhadantiko na tiṭṭhabhadantiko nābhihataṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.
an3.156:2.3: So na kumbhimukhā paṭigaṇhāti na kaḷopi-mukhā paṭigaṇhāti na eḷakamantaraṃ na daṇḍamantaraṃ na musalamantaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na purisantaragatāya na saṅkittisu na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti na yattha makkhikā saṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thusodakaṃ pivati.
an3.156:2.4: So ekāgāriko vā hoti ekālopiko dvāgāriko vā hoti dvālopiko . . . pe . . . sattāgāriko vā hoti satālopiko,
an3.156:2.5: ekissāpi dattiyā yāpeti dvīhi pi dattīhi yāpeti . . . pe . . . sattahi pi dattīhi yāpeti,
an3.156:2.6: ekāhikam pi āhāraṃ āhāreti dvīhikam pi āhāraṃ āhāreti . . . pe . . . sattāhikam pi āhāraṃ āhāreti iti evarūpaṃ aḍḍhamāsikam pi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogam anuyutto viharati,
an3.156:3.1: so sākabhakkho pi hoti sāmākabhakkho pi hoti nīvārabhakkho pi hoti daddulabhakkho pi hoti haṭabhakkho pi hoti kaṇabhakkho pi hoti ācāmabhakkho pi hoti piññākabhakkho pi hoti tiṇabhakkho pi hoti gomayabhakkho pi hoti, vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī:
an3.156:4.1: so sāṇāni pi dhāreti masāṇāni pi dhāreti chavadussāni pi dhāreti paṃsukūlāni pi dhāreti tirīṭāni pi dhāreti ajināni pi dhāreti ajinakkhipam pi dhāreti kusacīram pi dhāreti vākacīram pi dhāreti phalakacīram pi dhāreti kesakambalam pi dhāreti vālakambalaṃ pi dhāreti ulūkapakkhikam pi dhāreti;
an3.156:4.4: ukkuṭiko pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānam anuyutto pi hoti,
an3.156:4.5: kaṇṭakāpassayiko pi hoti kaṇṭakāpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti,
an3.156:4.6: sāyaṃ tatiyakam pi udakorohanānuyogam anuyutto viharati,
an3.156:4.7: iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto viharati.
an3.156:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ, citte,
an3.156:5.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
an3.157:1.3: Āgāḷhā paṭipadā, nijjhāmā paṭipadā, majjhimā paṭipadā.
an3.157:1.4: Katamā ca bhikkhave āgāḷhā paṭipadā? . . . pe [151.1] . . .
an3.157:2.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave nijjhāmā paṭipadā? . . . pe [151.2] . . .
an3.157:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
an3.157:3.3: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
an3.157:3.4: anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
an3.157:3.5: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati . . . pe . . . chandapadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ
